parsed.answer: The corpus only addresses RA-induced IEX-1 expression in NB4 and KG1 cells, plus an unrelated glioblastoma AMPA-receptor/Akt pathway. Neither excerpt mentions DIF2 cells, and neither reports assays of transcriptionally active promoter hallmarks (e.g., H3K4me3, H3K27ac, promoter-proximal Pol II). The NB4 portion of the claim is at best tangential, and the DIF2/promoter-hallmark components are wholly unsupported.
